title: tab/cdpEvent
description: Engine-to-shell notification: a message from the tab's DevTools agent (CefDevToolsMessageObserver::OnDevToolsMessage), unchanged: a response `{id, result | error}` to a tab/cdp command or an event `{method, params}`. A tab/cdp for a tab that does not exist is answered here with error -32000.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).
